data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices. [T-2836] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
